主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on January 23, 2015. The filing includes an exhibit titled 'Brookfield to Establish Global Facilities Management Business,' which outlines the company's plans to expand into the global facilities management sector. The report was signed by A.J. Silber, the Corporate Secretary of Brookfield Asset Management Inc. This filing is part of the company's regulatory disclosures and reflects its strategic direction in the financial services industry.
